candidates.title: Undead Murder Farce
candidates.reason: Across all 13 episodes of the 2023 anime, immortal disembodied detective Aya Rindo, half-oni fighter Tsugaru and attendant Shizuku investigate supernatural murders while pursuing the person who stole Aya's body. Victorian-European cases involving a murdered vampire, a contested jewel theft and killings across human and werewolf villages reward deduction from clues, disguise detection, conflicting testimony and knowledge of creature-specific vulnerabilities. A rival criminal faction, competing investigators and literary figures such as Sherlock Holmes and Arsene Lupin create cat-and-mouse pursuits, alliances, reversals and tactical clashes; vampires, oni, werewolves and other monsters bring varied supernatural abilities and an unusual alternate-history world. The tone combines sharp banter and bizarre gothic comedy with murders, persecution, occasional bloody violence and a brutal village massacre. Important limitations: mystery-solving rather than sustained psychological warfare is the core, power training and systematic ability progression are nearly absent, and the supernatural rules are case-specific rather than a deep unified power system. Violence is often discussed rather than graphically shown. Whole-season reviews disagree about action quality and animation, with criticism of inconsistent compositing, an overcrowded jewel-heist arc, distracting fanservice, uneven final-case logic and an unresolved overarching search for Aya's body. Evidence covers only the 2023 television adaptation, not later source material.
